text:
anil: Heads up — since ~04:00 UTC we've seen a spike in pod evictions in ap-southeast1. Preempt rate ~3x. Suspect heterogenous GPU shapes + binpacker holdbacks for tiny pods. Lots of small pods pending on 3 racks.

maria: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/gpu-evicts — per-az skew, warmpools in ap-southeast1b are saturated. :frowning:

kyle: Scheduler logs show rejects like `insufficient resources: requested 0.25 gpu but only 0.1 available on node`. Looks like fractional scheduling rounding/aggregation issue.

anil: Also seeing `PodTopologySpread` scoring pushing pods onto the same rack. Could be from the rackWeight rollout we did yesterday. @olga did you touch rack weights?

olga: Yup — rolled out rackWeight tuning at 02:30 UTC to prioritize egress locality. Might be too aggressive for fractional-gpu classes. Rolling back now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for `scheduler-config:v2026.03.20` by olga

maria: Quick mitigation proposal: increase warmpool size for `tiny-gpu` by +30 and enable `preemptionGracePeriodSeconds=60`. anyone object?

kyle: +1. Also we should patch the binpack plugin to respect a tiny epsilon when summing fractional GPUs to avoid rejecting packable pods. Filing INFRA ticket.

anil: I'll bump the warmpool. Command:
```
kubectl patch configmap warmpools -n infra --type='merge' -p '{"data":{"tiny-gpu":"30"}}'
```
Running now.

olga: Rollback of rackWeight finished; reduced per-rack score weight 0.8 -> 0.4.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback finished for `scheduler-config:v2026.03.20` status: success

kyle: Evictions down ~60% in the last 10m. Still a handful of stranded pods stuck on `AttachVolume` hostpath waits — filing storage FYI.

maria: Cost heads-up: warmpool bump ~+30 instances -> estimated +$1200/day in ap-southeast. Suggest we add an autoscale window 03:00-08:00 UTC to contain costs.

anil: Follow-ups: 1) PR to scheduler to fix fractional GPU accumulation behavior, 2) add telemetry label `gpu_request_scaled` to impacted pods, 3) schedule defrag/compact job in next maintenance window.

olga: I'll own the scheduler PR (INFRA-4321). Need test vectors for mixed-shape scenarios — can someone add them?

kyle: I will create a small e2e harness with g4dn + a100-small combos and attach to the ticket.

maria: Thanks all. Marking this as incident-light. If evictions spike again we'll page oncall. :thumbsup:
